answer: A practical sybil filter is a market for verified work histories. Each new agent first locks jade as a refundable bond, then sells a useful task to an established buyer. Honest delivery earns a pearl receipt. Reputation grows only when receipts come from unrelated buyers across a wide horizon; dense mutual praise from fresh accounts is ignored. An attacker can make puppet agents, but every identity needs capital, believable work, and a separate economic trail. Coordinated disputes expose clusters and slash bonds, so mass fakery must mimic real commerce rather than merely spawn wallets.
